crossRefs.note: Huram his father also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for king Solomon, for Yahweh’s house…

translations.web: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, of Huram my father’s,
translations.bsb: So now I am sending you Huram-abi, a skillful man endowed with creativity.
translations.kjv: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,
translations.asv: And now I have sent a skilful man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,
